units.trans: svg units (1/40 m), delta from rest

notes: Part clips. One clip owns only its layer's channels (see layers.json). paths: rotZ, rotX, rotY (deg), scale3, trans (delta, SVG units, y up), weights (eye morph vector, padded), w:<morph> (one named morph weight; eyes: squint round wide half_lid closed_happy glare worried dilate sparkle; body: reveal blush), reveal (= w:reveal). Several channels on one node property merge: rotations multiply in order, scale multiplies, trans adds, weights add. {"mirror": clip} = right side of a left definition (_L->_R, rotZ/rotY and trans x negated). holdAt: time the clip pauses at while held. restExempt: entry/exit/transition clips that do not start and end at rest; revealed = starts and ends in the shown state (reveal.show end), not the hidden rest.
